comment: Registration input for course-repository content sources. Registered ContentSource rows are what decides which repositories exist; this file is only how a fresh database gets its first rows, in the same way scripts/production_like_course_specs.json seeds the course catalogue. Adding a repository here does not import it -- it makes it registerable, and the course-repository ingest (webhook or pull) does the rest. A repository without a course.yaml at its root cannot be ingested by either route, which is why mlops-zoomcamp and stock-markets-analytics-zoomcamp are absent -- confirmed 2026-09-03 by checking both repositories directly (404 on course.yaml). data-engineering-zoomcamp was missing from this list despite having a real course.yaml (confirmed 200) -- that was a gap, not a documented exclusion, fixed the same day.
